inventory.label: a strip of dried apple
inventory.notes: Mira gave the second half back today; YY has not eaten it yet. The day did not feel like an apple day.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY did not eat much today; the apple Mira returned is still in the kitchen.
Yesterday: Mira added *the squirrel who reads* to her ledger.

Today: read Korv's death — old age, foot let go, no struggle. Did not take the offered primary feather. Brought the reading to Mira; she added it to the column. The morning will need a new clock; that is now part of his job.
Standing thread: the feather's role-meaning is the thing being tested. He chose not to add a second feather. The choice was not hard.
